label: U.S. Treasury Fiscal Data
terms_note: Open data, no key, no documented rate limit. HTML docs (no OpenAPI). Filters are one `filter` parameter of comma-joined field:operator:value conditions; pagination is page[number]/page[size] with meta.total-count. An unknown security description answers 200 {"data":[]} (no error); a malformed date answers 200 with no data as well (live 2026-10-01).

get_series.note: Monthly average interest rate (percent) of one kind of Treasury security. series_id is the security description exactly as published, e.g. 'Treasury Bills', 'Treasury Notes', 'Treasury Bonds', 'Treasury Inflation-Protected Securities (TIPS)', 'Total Marketable'. start/end are YYYY-MM-DD.

not_offered.get_candles: No OHLC data in Fiscal Data.
not_offered.search_symbols: No series search endpoint; the security descriptions are listed in the dataset's data dictionary (see get_series note).
